criterion: A source is split-eligible when ONE loot event is shared by a party that killed it together. Company alone is not enough: group content with per-player loot (Wintertodt, GOTR, Trawler) and crowded solo content (thieving, slayer caves, instanced bosses with busy lobbies) are deliberately excluded.
raid_rooms_excluded: Individual room bosses (Xarpus, Sotetseg, Bloat, Akkha, Ba-Ba, Scavenger beast, ...) are NOT listed: only the raid chest carries loot worth splitting. Verified against player_npc_hourly_totals - Xarpus is 87k gp across 91,723 drops (0 gp/drop) and Sotetseg 70k across 94,370, against 1-2M gp per raid-chest drop. Two room ids do carry value and are called out for review rather than silently included: Tekton (385M over 182 drops, ~2.1M each - almost certainly misattributed CoX purples) and Cache of runes (3.4B over 10,749).
